dedupe_keys.name: enac air traffic data dashboard for italian airports passengers cargo and movements since 2001

description: Italy's civil aviation authority ENAC runs an interactive dashboard of air traffic data for all Italian airports open to commercial traffic, launched in July 2025 with a mobile version in December 2025. It gives passengers, cargo and aircraft movements per airport, analyses of destinations and historical series, with data from 2001 and current data updated to the previous month. Users choose periods and download the results in Excel format; ENAC also publishes yearly traffic data reports. The dashboard is online and free to use, within ENAC's open data programme, but no licence is stated on the pages read. Coverage is national at airport level. Caveats: the data are reached through the dashboard, not as bulk files or an API, so a long series needs several downloads, and route detail is limited to destination analyses. The series supports airport capacity planning and national air network flow studies, and relates to the German, Dutch and Brazilian airport statistics catalogued here.
